all of render_item/convert_item: halo_attenuate, tight_alpha_crop, fit_material (_premultiplied_resize), quantize_material (_median_cut_palette), apply_local_inner_rim (inward anchors, border variant, rim median cut, run smoothing), hairlines; not the unused _tiny_border_color/_tiny_outline_pixels/_exterior helpers

_label_components, _negative_space, _pool_source (no symmetry branch), _promote_edges, _has_component_path, _component_path_evidence, _preserve_component_paths, _grammar_mask, _contour, _apply_material_rim, _hue_family, allocate_adaptive_palette; not slice_sheet_components, apply_inner_border, _apply_selective_vibrance, _apply_pixel_palette_style

files.source: prompts/items/*.txt (42 files; sha256 of their sorted sha256sum listing)
files.scope: the item house style: opening, presentation clauses, verbatim closing conventions (prompts.test.ts reads the files)
approach only: flat named guide colours (GROUND 140, FACE 78), no grid lines, 'Return the same framing at the same size'

pillow.from: Pillow 12.3.0 src/libImaging/Resample.c (precompute_coeffs, normalize_coeffs_8bpc, ImagingResampleInner), BoxBlur.c (_gaussian_blur_radius, ImagingLineBoxBlur8, ImagingBoxBlur), Geometry.c (ImagingScaleAffine), Convert.c (rgbA2rgba, rgba2rgbA), PIL/Image.py resize; checked byte-for-byte by pil.test.ts against fixtures/pixel/pillow (scripts/pixel-pillow.py)

opencv.from: OpenCV 4 getStructuringElement(MORPH_ELLIPSE), erode/dilate with the default border, connectedComponentsWithStats (8-way); checked against the definition by cv.test.ts and end to end by the item references

port_notes: NumPy float32 semantics are reproduced where they decide pixels: comparisons of float32 arrays with Python floats happen in float32 (NEP 50); strided float32 block sums use NumPy's pairwise sum over buffered chunks of whole rows (8192 elements), contiguous blocks one pairwise run; axis-(0,1) sums of (h,w,3) accumulate sequentially. Established empirically against NumPy 2.5.4.
Python round()/np.rint are half-to-even (py.ts roundHalfEven); colorsys is ported verbatim; Python float % is reproduced.

Set and dict iteration orders in items.py (boundary sets, outline dicts) were checked not to affect results: palettes and smoothing are order-independent by construction (total-order sorts, deferred updates).

Not ported (rejected with PixelError, none used by a preset): before (blur/sharpen/grading), vibrance, dither, noise (needs NumPy's PCG64 stream), outline: outer, cleanup.symmetry, alpha: smooth, downscale: median, render_family/render_batch/palette_for_batch.
